patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed, dark background with content sections often centered or aligned to a subtle grid, maintaining generous vertical spacing between major content blocks.
Headings are consistently very large, bold, and sans-serif, creating strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, clean body text and uppercase labels for sub-sections or metadata.
A high-contrast dark theme dominates, featuring a black background, white primary text, vibrant blue for interactive elements and accents, and a distinct orange for calls-to-action and highlights.
The hero section features a dynamic text transformation, where the main heading changes content and styling as the user scrolls down, accompanied by a parallaxing, animated background texture.
The footer/contact section transitions into a generative art animation with radiating blue lines that dynamically expand from the center, creating a sense of depth and energy.
Content sections frequently employ a grid-based layout for showcasing items like 'pioneers' or 'stories,' using cards with subtle borders and clear calls to action.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a full-bleed, interactive background powered by WebGL/Three.js and canvas, which subtly animates and parallaxes with scroll, creating a dynamic and immersive visual experience.
Hero text undergoes a scroll-triggered content and style transformation, where the initial message animates into a new statement as the user scrolls past the initial viewport.
Scroll-triggered animations, likely orchestrated by a smooth scrolling library like Locomotive Scroll, reveal content sections with subtle fade-ins or shifts as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~6x body text) with clean, legible body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for all UI elements, buttons, and content containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding within content blocks, contributing to a premium and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly dynamic and interactive background, which leverages WebGL/canvas to create evolving textures and geometric animations that respond to scroll. This transforms the page from a static layout into a living, breathing experience, making the content feel integrated into a larger, immersive environment.
